item.title: De Silvestro set for Italy’s Bobsleigh Olympic team
item.description: Former IndyCar Series racer Simona de Silvestro’s dream of qualifying for the Winter Olympics has become a reality as the Swiss-Italian will represent Italy in Bobsleigh competition.

item.title: Race Industry Week: Kaulig's Chris Rice on Ram's return to NASCAR Trucks
item.description: A new manufacturer era is coming to the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, and Kaulig Racing will be at the center of it.

item.title: Jeff Gordon, Kurt Busch join IROC line-up at Heritage Invitational
item.description: NASCAR Hall of Famers Jeff Gordon and Kurt Busch have been added to the driver lineup for IROC Presented By Chevrolet, which will make its Ten Tenths Motor Club debut during the Heritage Invitational on Friday, April 10, in Concord, North Carolina. item.title: Saturday Clash qualifying heats at Bowman Gray postponed due to weather
item.description: The Cook Out Clash events on Saturday, Jan. 31, including NASCAR Cup Series practice, qualifying, and heat races at Bowman Gray Stadium, have been postponed out of an abundance of caution due to expected winter weather in the Winston-Salem, N.C. area.

item.title: Penske completes engineering and strategist line-ups
item.description: Josef Newgarden’s No. 2 Team Penske Chevy entry will feature consistency on its timing stand as the Tennessean’s trusted Indianapolis 500-winning race engineer Luke Mason and Indy-winning race strategist Jonathan Diuguid are staying in place for 2026.

item.title: Stewart ready to lean on some old tricks - and embrace the unknowns - in Truck Series cameo at Daytona

item.title: No hard feelings and lots to look forward to as Power begins his Andretti era
item.description: Will Power is too experienced to let the uncomfortable end to his tenure at Team Penske become a distraction as he shifts into the final phase of his IndyCar career with Andretti Global.

item.title: Mercedes stays ahead, Aston struggles on fourth day of Barcelona F1 shakedown
item.description: Mercedes wrapped up its track time in Barcelona with another strong day in terms of both performance and reliability, while Aston Martin's new car turns just five laps.

item.title: Cindric returns to Penske as McLaughlin’s race strategist
item.description: Tim Cindric’s next job in the sport will be with a familiar group as Team Penske’s former president has accepted an offer to return and serve as Scott McLaughlin’s race strategist with the No. 3 Team Penske Chevy IndyCar program.

item.title: Aston Martin focusing on Honda integration as AMR26 finally breaks cover
item.description: Aston Martin hopes to work on integrating its new Honda power unit during the final day of Formula 1's shakedown in Barcelona, after finally hitting the track with the AMR26 on Thursday.
